description: Connect Agents to trusted local image-generation backends without silent downloads or switches.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex or Claude Code to trusted local visual asset backends.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex or Claude Code to an existing AUTOMATIC1111/Forge, ComfyUI, or Diffusers visual asset backend through an installed MCP CLI. Adaptive briefing, bounded local model discovery, user-local trust, deterministic routes, durable review, byte-bound finalization, and immutable revisions keep control explicit. No model weights are bundled or downloaded implicitly. Model-free tests cover WebUI and ComfyUI adapter contracts. Real ComfyUI generation evidence remains local development validation rather than public acceptance evidence; the complete real 9+3 host/vision acceptance matrix is not retained. The ordinary SDXL route is the pending golden path; regional and two-stage composition remain experimental and do not establish visual-quality improvement.
